"""Evolvable cache replacement policy starting from LRU baseline."""

from collections import OrderedDict


class EvolvedCache:
    """Byte-based cache with evolvable replacement policy."""
    
    # EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
    def __init__(self, capacity_bytes):
        self.capacity = capacity_bytes
        self.current_size = 0
        self.hits = 0
        self.misses = 0
        # ARC-inspired: T1 (recency) + T2 (frequency) + ghost lists B1, B2
        # p = target size for T1 (adapts dynamically)
        self.t1 = OrderedDict()  # recently accessed once
        self.t2 = OrderedDict()  # accessed more than once (hot)
        self.b1 = OrderedDict()  # ghost of evicted T1 items (ids only)
        self.b2 = OrderedDict()  # ghost of evicted T2 items (ids only)
        self.t1_size = 0
        self.t2_size = 0
        self.t1_sz = {}   # obj_id -> size for t1
        self.t2_sz = {}   # obj_id -> size for t2
        self.p = 0  # target bytes for T1
        self.ghost_max = 2000  # max ghost entries

    def _evict_one(self):
        """Evict one item using ARC policy (T1 vs T2 based on p)."""
        if self.t1 and (self.t1_size >= max(1, self.p) or not self.t2):
            eid, _ = self.t1.popitem(last=False)
            esz = self.t1_sz.pop(eid)
            self.t1_size -= esz
            self.current_size -= esz
            self.b1[eid] = esz
            if len(self.b1) > self.ghost_max:
                self.b1.popitem(last=False)
        elif self.t2:
            eid, _ = self.t2.popitem(last=False)
            esz = self.t2_sz.pop(eid)
            self.t2_size -= esz
            self.current_size -= esz
            self.b2[eid] = esz
            if len(self.b2) > self.ghost_max:
                self.b2.popitem(last=False)
        elif self.t1:
            eid, _ = self.t1.popitem(last=False)
            esz = self.t1_sz.pop(eid)
            self.t1_size -= esz
            self.current_size -= esz
            self.b1[eid] = esz
            if len(self.b1) > self.ghost_max:
                self.b1.popitem(last=False)

    def _evict_to_fit(self, obj_size):
        """Evict until obj_size bytes are free."""
        while self.current_size + obj_size > self.capacity and (self.t1 or self.t2):
            self._evict_one()

    def access(self, obj_id, obj_size):
        """Process an access request. Returns True for hit, False for miss."""
        # Cache hit in T1 -> promote to T2
        if obj_id in self.t1_sz:
            sz = self.t1_sz.pop(obj_id)
            self.t1.pop(obj_id)
            self.t1_size -= sz
            self.current_size -= sz
            self.t2[obj_id] = 1
            self.t2_sz[obj_id] = sz
            self.t2_size += sz
            self.current_size += sz
            self.hits += 1
            return True

        # Cache hit in T2 -> move to MRU end
        if obj_id in self.t2_sz:
            self.t2.move_to_end(obj_id)
            self.hits += 1
            return True

        # Miss
        self.misses += 1
        if obj_size > self.capacity:
            return False

        # Ghost hit in B1: increase p (favor recency), admit to T2
        if obj_id in self.b1:
            ghost_sz = self.b1.pop(obj_id)
            # Scale delta by ratio of ghost size to avg object size
            b1_count = max(1, len(self.b1) + 1)
            b2_count = max(1, len(self.b2))
            delta = ghost_sz * max(1, b2_count // b1_count)
            self.p = min(self.p + delta, self.capacity)
            self._evict_to_fit(obj_size)
            self.t2[obj_id] = 1
            self.t2_sz[obj_id] = obj_size
            self.t2_size += obj_size
            self.current_size += obj_size
            return False

        # Ghost hit in B2: decrease p (favor frequency), admit to T2
        if obj_id in self.b2:
            ghost_sz = self.b2.pop(obj_id)
            b1_count = max(1, len(self.b1))
            b2_count = max(1, len(self.b2) + 1)
            delta = ghost_sz * max(1, b1_count // b2_count)
            self.p = max(self.p - delta, 0)
            self._evict_to_fit(obj_size)
            self.t2[obj_id] = 1
            self.t2_sz[obj_id] = obj_size
            self.t2_size += obj_size
            self.current_size += obj_size
            return False

        # Cold miss: evict and admit to T1
        self._evict_to_fit(obj_size)
        self.t1[obj_id] = 1
        self.t1_sz[obj_id] = obj_size
        self.t1_size += obj_size
        self.current_size += obj_size
        return False
    # EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
    
    def hit_rate(self):
        """Return the hit rate as a fraction."""
        total = self.hits + self.misses
        return self.hits / total if total > 0 else 0.0
